Program Development Office
The Capitol
Frankfort, Kentucky 40601
MEMORANDUM
TO:
Mr. Wellborn Adams, Acting Commissioner
FROM:
Tom Craighead Touterniqued
SUBJECT:
Endangered Species Conservation Act of 1972
DATE:
April 18, 1972
For the benefit of the Bureau of Sport Fisheries and Wildlife, the Physical Resources Coordinating Commission functions as the State Clearinghouse for draft environmental statements submitted pursuant to section 102(2) (C) of PL91-190. The Commission consists of eleven member agencies of state government, including the Kentucky Program Development Office designated as the State A-95 Clearinghouse.
In most cases each member agency will receive a copy of the statement and each forthcoming response will be forwarded to the Commission Chairman, presently Commissioner of the Department of Natural Resources. The Chairman will in turn forward the responses, either in total or individually, to the agency submitting the draft statement. In this particular situation only the member agencies of Agriculture, Natural Resources, Fish and Wildlife, and KPDO were selected to review the draft environmental statement.
We feel that the proposed legislation will provide considerable improvement in efforts to provide for the conservation, protection, and propogation of endangered species of fish and wildlife. The effort to keep a species from becoming endangered rather than attempting to save it after it has reached the critical point is extremely important. Both federal and state coordination procedures seem to be acceptable. The single list of endangered species and the removal of current ceilings on the acquisition of habitat are steps in the right direction.
